reviewer_summary.question: Why must a chosen word go through processing before choosing the following word, and which earlier calculations can each layer keep?
reviewer_summary.takeaway: Choosing blue uses is’s finished number; processing blue creates its own finished number, while separate layer caches save earlier keys and values without replacing the retained text.

findings.problem: Fractions, sum-to-one and the single-source 100 percent conclusion arrive before a concrete fractional reading.

resolution.note: Show taking the whole 0.8 reading number first; name its share afterward.

findings.problem: Extra sharing parts precede the spoken rule; unclear whether a match of 0.25 is already 25 percent.

resolution.note: Removed this beat. Calculate a concrete positive match plus one, then name sharing parts.

findings.problem: That position seems to refer to the blank rather than is.

resolution.note: Explicitly name is and show each supplied word’s allowed set.

findings.problem: Rebuilding value seems automatically to rebuild the reading.

resolution.note: Separate taking the whole rebuilt value from the subsequent addition to input.

findings.problem: Value is used before its prepared-reading-number definition.

resolution.note: Use plain reading number until value is named after the complete first stage.

findings.problem: Layer is used before stage and layer are connected.

resolution.note: Say stage on the first completed stage; define layer in the next beat.
